text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Make Debut drawing 
close, I headed out to the training track 
with Mejiro Ardan, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... The one over there is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! As expected of you, 
Yaeno-san...! Your running has gotten even 
sharper than before...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Chiyono O-san, you clearly showed 
the fruits of your daily training. Seeing 
that really tightened my focus too.

Where Mejiro Ardan was looking, two 
Umamusume stood, pushing each other to 
greater heights.

One of them is Sakura Chiyono O. She's a 
cheerful Umamusume known for her 
earnestness and hardworking nature.

The other is Yaeno Muteki. Reminiscent of 
a classical martial artist, she's an 
Umamusume who leaves quite a striking, 
dignified impression.

Both of them belong to the same generation 
as Mejiro Ardan...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You both seem to be working diligently. —I 
must follow your example.
choice_data_list: So you two are close, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. —Both of them are very precious 
friends of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Especially since Chiyonoo-san is my 
roommate... She helped me pack when I was 
hospitalized and discharged, and even came 
to visit me—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's your discharge day! I'm so 
glad you can safely return to the 
academy...! Congratulations, Ardan-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you as always.

Mejiro Ardan's words reminded me of how 
Sakura Chiyono O had once gone to greet 
her upon her discharge from the 
hospital...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Truly... thank you for everything you 
always do for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ardan-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
――Are you heading out to train on the 
track now too, Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since the Make Debut is right around 
the corner, I plan to kick things into 
high gear.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The time is finally here...! I'm so 
excited to run in the Twinkle Series 
alongside you, Ardan-san!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I feel the exact same way as Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As your classmate, I am truly glad to 
compete alongside you. For now, allow me 
to cheer you on in your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I am honored. To hear such words from 
the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"In my upcoming debut race, I intend to 
stake my very life and soul on the line."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So as for whether I can run alongside you 
two... I am truly sorry, but with this 
body of mine, I cannot make any promises.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I must be getting to my 
training, so I shall take my leave here. I 
will see you both later—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, shall we get going?

Before I could even process my surprise at 
her words, she had already walked off to 
begin her training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—*Haa*... *haa*... ...Heart rate and legs 
are fine. Then for the next set—

As her debut race approached, Mejiro 
Ardan's intensity grew, pushing herself 
today as if searching for the absolute 
limits of her endurance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So as for whether I can run alongside you 
two... I am truly sorry, but with this 
body of mine, I cannot make any promises.

The weight of Mejiro Ardan's resolve for a 
single race... As her trainer, I thought I 
had understood it to some extent.

However, I couldn't have imagined she 
would show such fierce determination even 
to the friends reaching out to her.

Wondering how Sakura Chiyono O and the 
others took Mejiro Ardan's words, I felt a 
slight pang of concern—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Um, Ardan's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to interrupt your training. Do 
you have a moment to talk...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Regarding Ardan-san, well――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is so sudden, it probably makes 
no sense, right? Um, well, the thing is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“—Back when Ardan-san was frequently in 
and out of the hospital, sometimes... only 
very rarely, but she'd have this somewhat 
lonely look on her face—”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I noticed it, Ardan-san would 
always give a gentle smile... and I felt 
as though I was forcing her to push 
herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“B-But lately, Miss Ardan has been smiling 
with pure joy so much more than before! 
And her drive during solo training has 
grown even fiercer—”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Watching you like that, Ardan-san, makes 
me happy too... and makes me feel like I 
have to do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
――The reason Ardan-san changed like that 
was after the selection race, once her 
Trainer joined her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't cheer Ardan-san up on my 
own... So, I wanted to thank you, 
Trainer—"
choice_data_list:
...You really pay close attention to 
Ardan, don't you?

...You really pay close attention to 
Ardan, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, it's not so much keeping an eye on 
her as, um, I'm the one always being 
looked after! She's a very precious 
roommate to me—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Ardan-san said that earlier, but I 
still believe in her."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"For Ardan-san to run her debut race to 
the end, and to run together with me and 
Yaeno-san!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san's feelings towards racing... 
Even I understand at least a little how 
strong they truly are."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However... I won't lose when it comes to 
feelings! So when we face off one day, 
I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Especially in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby)... I absolutely will not lose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so sorry for taking up so much of 
your time! I really should get going now! 
Thank you for your hard work!"

Mejiro Ardan's friends also believe she 
will rise to the top of the Twinkle 
Series...

Then as her Trainer, I must do everything 
I can so that Mejiro Ardan can fulfill 
those feelings...!

At the same time. In the academy's 
training gym—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Final stretch...!!
(Clatter!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. Next is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So as for whether I can run alongside you 
two... I am truly sorry, but with this 
body of mine, I cannot make any promises.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—That is indeed what you said today. Yet, 
I am certain...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to the day you stand before 
me as a true "champion"...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That intuition hasn't changed since that 
day when I first saw your running in the 
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――By a razor-thin margin, Mejiro Ardan!! 
She drove through that very last stride!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place in this debut race is 
Mejiro Ardan!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
――I trembled. 1200m on dirt. Transcending 
aptitudes, best distances, transcending 
everything, as she seized victory before 
our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I felt a tenacity, or perhaps a 
conviction, from your running that I 
myself don't possess...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ardan-san. Your legs—and the raging 
fire hidden within them—surely weren't 
meant to end after just a single debut 
race."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When the day comes for us to vie for 
supremacy, so that I may face you with 
everything I have, I—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Nothing left but to train!

As each of their feelings quietly 
intertwined, Mejiro Ardan's debut race was 
about to begin...!
